messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Realtime EU streaming p99 latency breach detected. p99=1.2s (SLO=800ms). Affected route: /v1/stream (prod). Trigger: latency-detector-rt. Pager: oncall-1.

oncall-1: I'm on it, joining the bridge. @emma can you pull the realtime dashboard? @jordan please check any customer-facing queues for errors. :eyes:

emma (eng-sre): Opening dashboard -> https://grafana.redwood/local/d/realtime-eu?panelId=7
emma (eng-sre): quick snapshot: p95 ~320ms steady, p99 jumped to 1.2-1.5s starting at ~10:41 UTC. Error rate unchanged. Top actors: inference-group-eu-3 showing tail CPU spikes.
matt (eng-runtime): Running quick node check and logs.
```bash
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=realtime-eu -o wide
# output (truncated)
realtime-eu-1   Running  3/3   10.0.3.21  node-eu-1
realtime-eu-2   Running  3/3   10.0.3.22  node-eu-2
realtime-eu-3   Running  2/3   10.0.3.23  node-eu-3   # high CPU
```
priya (eng-ml): Could be a KV cache miss storm after model changes. Any deploys in last 2h?
oncall-1: No app deploys in the last 2h. We did a quantized model rollout yesterday evening.
emma (eng-sre): KV cache hit-rate dropped from ~95% to ~40% at spike time — looks like prefix cache thrash on eu-3.
jordan (support): Customer impact: a few sessions had slow transcript updates; no hard failures. One premium account (acct-438) reported delayed streaming updates. Sending them a note.
oncall-1: Initial mitigation plan: route traffic for /v1/stream to eu-fallback-1 (variant without prefix KV enabled) and request autoscale burst +2 nodes from dedicated pool. Performing route shift now. :arrow_right:
incident-bot: Action registered: routing-shift started -> rs-482 (target=eu-fallback-1).
matt (eng-runtime): Requesting burst capacity to dedicated-eu pool (+2 nodes). CLI request submitted.
emma (eng-sre): Autoscale burst accepted, provisioning ~45s. Monitoring metrics.
oncall-1: Watching p99 trend...
emma (eng-sre): p99 trending down: 1.2s -> 790ms -> 680ms over last 80s. p95 steady ~300ms.
jordan (support): Notified affected customer about transient latency, offered status updates.
oncall-1: :white_check_mark: moving to watch phase. If p99 breaches again, escalate to full SRE war room and re-open paging. Continue 5m observation window.
